caseName: BRANIGIN Et Al. v. DUDDLESTON Et Al.
caseNameFull: Roger D. Branigin v. Dorothy S. Duddleston
attorneys: John J. Dillon, Attorney General of Indiana, and Charles S. White for appellants in No. 1252. Marshall F. Kiser for appellant in No. 1263., Leslie Duvall and William H. Sparrenberger for appel-lees in both cases.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to affirm are granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Harlan, for reasons contained in his memorandum of March 4, 1968 (390 U. S. 932, sub nom. Branigin v. Grills), in which he acquiesced in the denial of stays of enforcement of the District Court’s judgment, also acquiesces in the Court’s affirmance of that judgment.
